summary: Thirst, and thirst as longing. Buddhist Chinese calls the craving that keeps rebirth turning 渴愛, thirst-love.
placement: Chosen by farthest-point sampling on the integrated Newton–Leipnik trajectory, so the eight stars spread across its projected shape. 魂 takes the highest of the eight points and 魄 the lowest, after the Liji’s 魂氣歸于天，形魄歸于地. A design choice, not a claim.

satellites.title: The Sickness of Thirst
satellites.evidence: The Nirvana Sutra speaks of freeing beings from 二十五有渴愛之病, the sickness of thirst-love through the twenty-five kinds of existence. Thirst is the illness that keeps rebirth going.

checked.note: 能令眾生悉得遠離二十五有渴愛之病

satellites.title: To the Thirsty, Any Drink Is Sweet
satellites.evidence: Mencius 7A27: 飢者甘食，渴者甘飲 — the hungry find any food sweet, the thirsty any drink; hunger and thirst spoil the palate, and need can spoil the heart the same way.
